senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Distressed, pained.
2 Exhausted, overpowered.
E.
ग्लै to be weary, causal form, क्त aff.

(उ) ग्लसु r. 1st cl. (ग्लसते)
To eat: see ग्रस.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Eaten.
E.
ग्लस to eat, affix क्त.

(उ) ग्लहु r. 1st and 10th cl. (ग्लहति-यति)
To take, to receive or accept: see ग्रह.

m. (-हः)
Gaming, playing with dice.
E.
ग्लह to take, &c. affix अच्, or it is derived irregularly from ग्रह, with अप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wearied, languid, feeble, exhausted by fatigue, disease, &c.
E.
ग्लै to be feeble, and क्त aff.

f. (-निः)
Langour, lassitude, fatigue of body or depression of mind.
E.
ग्ला or ग्लै to be weary, Uṇādi affix नि.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Being exhausted, languid, faint, &c.
E.
ग्लै to be weary, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-स्नुः-स्नुः-स्नु)
Exhausted by disease or fatigue, wearied, languid.
E.
ग्लै to be weak, affix स्नु.
